name: Non-booked Recovery
job: Follow-up burst for contacts that finished WF-01 but did not book. Excludes funnel_entry_* origins. Re-checks booking and routes stragglers to WF-09.

trigger.notes: Never enrolled directly by a form. Enrolled only via ADD-TO-WF from WF-01.

named_steps.name: TRIGGER: Added by WF-01 (not funnel_entry_*)
named_steps.comment: Sole enroll path for WF-02. Must not enroll funnel_entry_* origins.

named_steps.name: IF-ELSE: Skip if already booked (v2_status_booked)
named_steps.comment: Reads v2_status_booked and calendar-booked contact fields. Must not clear the booked tag.

named_steps.name: WAIT: +3 minutes (quiet-hours aware)
named_steps.comment: Short opening delay for burst step 1.

named_steps.name: SMS: Non-booked nudge 1 (3m)
named_steps.comment: Inline SMS. Honors quiet hours 8am-9pm contact TZ.

named_steps.name: SMS: Non-booked nudge 2 (5m)
named_steps.comment: Inline SMS. Members not patients, clinic not office.

named_steps.name: WAIT: +24 hours (quiet-hours aware)
named_steps.comment: Longer wait between morning outreach steps.

named_steps.name: IF-ELSE: Re-check booking (v2_status_booked)
named_steps.comment: Reads booked state after burst. Must not force appt_status.

named_steps.name: ADD-TO-WF: Route unbooked to WF-09 Nurture
named_steps.comment: Hand-off to nurture. Must not touch renewal_date; only WF-09 owns that trigger.
